IF(SM_Full_Payment__c =TRUE, "PAYMENT COMPLETED",
	IF (SM_Charged_SB_Fees2__c = 0 ,"WITHOUT PAYMENT REGISTER",
	   IF(
		  AND(
			 OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"),ISPICKVAL(Status, "Finalized")),
			 TEXT( SM_Way_of_Contract_Payment__c ) = "Fix Term",
			 SM_Charged_SB_Fees2__c >= SM_Plan_Months__c
		  ),
		  "PAYMENT COMPLETED",
		  IF(
			 TODAY() < SM_Next_installment_date__c  ,
			 "PAYMENTS UP TO DATE",
			 IF(
				SM_Next_installment_date__c = TODAY() ,
				"DUE TODAY",
				IF(TODAY() > SM_Next_installment_date__c,
				   "LATE PAYMENTS",
				   IF(
					  AND(
						 OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"),ISPICKVAL(Status, "Finalized")),
						 SM_Charged_SB_Fees2__c = 0,
						 SM_Plan_Months__c > 0
					  ),
					  "WITHOUT PAYMENT REGISTER",

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(AND(
   MONTH( SM_AC_start_date__c ) == MONTH( TODAY() ),
   YEAR( SM_AC_start_date__c ) == YEAR( TODAY() )
  )
 ,/* RAMA 1: MES DE INICIO (Seguro porque la fecha ya existe en el registro) */
  IF(ISPICKVAL(SM_Payment_methods__c,"ACH")
     ,CASE(MOD(SM_AC_start_date__c - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 0, SM_AC_start_date__c - 2, 6, SM_AC_start_date__c - 1, SM_AC_start_date__c)
     ,CASE(MOD(SM_AC_start_date__c - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7), 4, SM_AC_start_date__c + 4, 5, SM_AC_start_date__c + 4, 6, SM_AC_start_date__c + 3, SM_AC_start_date__c + 2)  
    )  
 ,/* RAMA 2: RECURRENTE (Blindada contra días 29, 30 y 31) */
  IF(NOT(ISNULL(SM_Payment_day__c)),
    /* Cálculo de la 'BaseDate': asegura que si el día no existe, use el último día del mes actual */
    IF(ISPICKVAL(SM_Payment_methods__c,"ACH")
     ,CASE( 
       MOD( (ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c) - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7),
       0, ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) - 2,
       6, ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) - 1,
       ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c))
     )
     ,CASE( 
       MOD( (ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c) - DATE(1900, 1, 7), 7),
       4, ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) + 4,
       5, ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) + 4,
       6, ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) + 3,
       ((ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - MAX(0, DAY(ADDMONTHS(DATE(YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(TODAY()), 1), 1) - 1) - SM_Payment_day__c)) + 2
      )  
    )  
   ,NULL
  )
)

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(NOT(Counts_As_Contract__c), "Not counted",
IF(AND(
     ISPICKVAL(Status, "Cancelled"),
     NOT(ISBLANK(Contract_Calculated_Start_Date__c)),
     NOT(ISBLANK(SM_Cancellation_date__c)),
     YEAR(SM_Cancellation_date__c) = YEAR(Contract_Calculated_Start_Date__c),
     MONTH(SM_Cancellation_date__c) = MONTH(Contract_Calculated_Start_Date__c)
   ), "Voided",
IF(IF(SM_Requires_AC_Payment__c,
      SM_AC_collected__c,
      OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"),
         ISPICKVAL(Status, "Finalized"),
         AND(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Cancelled"), NOT(ISBLANK(First_Accepted_Payment_Made_Date__c))))
   ), "Effective Sale",
IF(OR(Reached_Payment_Process__c,
      ISPICKVAL(Status, "Payment Process"),
      ISPICKVAL(Status, "Activated"),
      ISPICKVAL(Status, "Finalized"),
      SM_AC_collected__c,
      NOT(ISBLANK(First_Accepted_Payment_Made_Date__c))
   ), "Sale",
"Raw Sale"))))
fields.inlineHelpText: Sale level of the contract, from the official definition: Not counted (Dependent or test), Voided (cancelled in its first billing month), Raw Sale (contract created), Sale (reached Payment Process: the default 'sale') or Effective Sale (AC collected, or Activated when the product has no AC). Levels are nested: an Effective Sale is also a Sale and a Raw Sale. Dates: CreatedDate for Raw Sale and Sale, StartDate for Effective Sale.
fields.label: Sale Level
fields.name: Sale_Level__c

fields.inlineHelpText: Funnel step of the sale: 1 Raw Sale, 2 Sale, 3 Effective Sale, 0 not a sale (Not counted or Voided). Because the levels are nested, the funnel counts contracts with step 1 or more (Raw Sale), 2 or more (Sale) and 3 (Effective Sale).
